description: This file defines a Java entity class 'Course' for use with JPA/Hibernate ORM. It models a course with fields such as id, code, title, description, ownerId, and createdAt, including constructors, getters, setters, and ORM annotations.

classes.name: Course
classes.description: An ORM-mapped entity representing a course in the learning management system, with properties such as id, code, title, description, ownerId, and creation timestamp.
